result.summary: The page is generally clean and well-aligned, with one minor content defect: a truncated restaurant name in the Popular section. Horizontally scrollable clipped items and the partially visible card at the bottom were excluded as intentional.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant name reads 'Tokumaru Ramer' — the final letter of 'Ramen' appears truncated/misspelled, inconsistent with the 'Ramen' category shown directly below it.
issues.suggestion: Correct the title to the full restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' and verify the title field is not being clipped; allow the full text to render or truncate cleanly with an ellipsis if space is limited.
